title: The Development of Inverform and associated “Spin Offs”
version: Paper History, vol. 16, issue 2, printed pp. 22–26
lineage: Full paper-history issue; first-person retrospective by a participant in the development. The exact first output day and Webster’s first practical deployment are not established here.

passages.note: First-person account contrasts cylinder-mould and lower-wire-only forming, and describes the added top wire for upward drainage.

passages.locator: Printed p. 26 / PDF p. 26, Commercial Application at St. Anne’s
passages.note: Describes early-1958 installation, commercial operation during 1958, and independent concurrent work by David Webster in Canada.
